dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale edges visible along the distal borders of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse boundary where the uniform brownish-grey crown transitions into the scaled mantle pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive black facial mask and bib covering the lores, orbital region, and throat, contrasting sharply with a pale ivory-colored bill and light cheek area.
